rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Rebecca Mary
rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom, before 2006).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Dickson Nurseries Ltd. / Dickson Roses in 2009 as 'Rebecca Mary'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot, yellow shading. Mild, spice fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 35" (90cm). Width: 33" (85cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Named on occasion of Rebecca Mary Harris' 40th birthday by her husband Dr. Nick Harris.
Participated in the 2021 New Zealand trials at Palmerston North
